title: Daqaaral Amaanat le Aamanti
intro: Qusubih yooboke awkih mano qeedaalissol elle takarteh tan innal rooci foocal yakkem duude sinni amri. Qibaadah uguugus miraacisak, niya yirgiqeh yan amri oggolimteh, kee gaalik yan sirri awayih uddur, dubuk qammalsime wayta gital yandabben.
clues: Anu qusbih yooboke lab xaylo qidaanam amrise qanxaffele silaalak gubat mannoowa.
Qibaadah uguugus yoo fan yemeeteeh, qaago garuq kee sorkocô baxa biyaktah tan abto beyuh yoo amriseh.
Anu inni gaalik tan alqi alil daffeeseeh, caxitta daqaaral daffeese.
Yi sorkocô baxi foyyah yekkeeh, sirri qaddoosam faxak suge, takkay immay Yalli yi madqa maqarrooseh.
Anu numuk teyna ruubeh awkak safar kataatuh away quukah alil iroh.
awki geytimeh yan buxah marih gabat, kee ellecaboh, anu inni alqi luk qagitak ongoorowem kee dayla abeena ekke.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Is isi alqi alil daffessa hayteh daqar amol daffesse
Is isi baxa gablah addat qellisse
Is isi baxa masjid baabal cabte.
trial.answer: Is isi alqi alil daffessa hayteh daqar amol daffesse

location.label: Lafa le liyyitte
options: daqar amol leeh amoh alil daffeyte
location.answer: daqar amol leeh amoh alil daffeyte

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Is isi baxat garayteeh kaa urteh
Is gersi baaxo fan dabxeh sugteeh, diiriyoh addat mannowte
outcome.answer: Is isi baxat garayteeh kaa urteh

arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verse: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers." (28:7)
